choreographySelection.seedRule: The song, run ID, Format version, and ordered roster produce a reproducible default seed; --seed=<label> deliberately rerolls it.
choreographySelection.soloRule: All 25 bundled starter motions are eligible; the four solo assignments are distinct.
choreographySelection.finaleRule: Only motions lasting at least nine seconds are eligible; the four finale assignments are distinct.
choreographySelection.reactionRule: Reaction assignments are distinct while the catalog has enough compatible motions.
choreographySelection.withinRunRule: The official selector does not repeat any motion across the twelve assignments in one video.
choreographySelection.cooldownRule: The selector avoids the corresponding role assignments from the two most recent local runs and relaxes the oldest run first only when required.
choreographySelection.exclusionRule: Character-motion exclusions require preserved rendered evidence in assets/motion-exclusions.json.
